summary: PLAT-103: validateApp now rejects apps without a non-empty owner (libs/shared-contracts). core-shell (platform), sub-route-billing (payments) and sub-route-reports (insights) pass owner. Shipped in PR #1 (CI and CD green on main). Assumptions: sub-route-reports also calls validateApp, so it was updated too, or it would fail at startup; the three PLAT-103 sub-tasks shipped as one PR because the breaking change needs all callers together; owners are hard-coded to match each package.json team field, since the build inliner cannot read JSON; shared-contracts is in-repo and inlined, so no version bump or registry publish applies per CONTRIBUTING.md.
